assertions.assertion: Cornerstone United is the payer that issued the denial.
CPT 93271 corresponds to Cardiac Event Monitoring.
The denial was issued under Reason Code CO-97.
The CO-97 denial reason states the service is bundled and not separately payable.
A clinical indication note exists documenting the patient's condition.
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Transient cerebral ischemic attacks is coded as G45.9.
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
Unspecified cardiac arrhythmia is coded as I49.9.
The patient reports intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations.
The dizziness and palpitations are poorly correlated with standard ECG findings.
The cardiac event monitoring study is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other intermittent dysrhythmias.
Those dysrhythmias may be contributing to the patient's transient neurological symptoms.
The service is separately indicated (i.e., separately payable rather than bundled).
A request for reconsideration of the CO-97 denial and payment is being made.
